t: Genie Wish Syndrome and the Chisel-Strike: Mastering AI Collaboration in Fragile Systems
s: This article explores human-AI collaboration by contrasting 'genie wish syndrome' (literal fulfillment vs. underlying need) with 'chisel-strike' iterative development, emphasizing the transition from ambiguous language to verifiable code execution in complex systems.
sub: AI collaboration challenges in fragile systems
Genie wish syndrome vs. chisel-strike development
Limits of language vs. objective code execution
Meta-analysis of AI interaction and cognitive styles
Nix Flakes as an example of fragile system architecture
